Ambition: Its fitted Zetatech scope supports a blinding effect on hit. Blinded targets receive additional headshot damage for the effect's duration.
Apparition: At critical health, damage, firing speed and reload speed improve. A charged shot deals double damage.
Catahoula: Kills and dismemberments increase movement speed; moving faster increases damage. BARGHEST versions receive extra armor penetration.
Chaos: Reloading rerolls the weapon's damage type, critical-hit chance and status-effect application.
Cheetah: Critical-hit and bleeding chances increase as you approach your target. Torso hits receive extra damage.
Crimestopper: Hits can disable cybernetic limbs, immobilize the target and increase critical damage. Equipping the weapon briefly raises critical-hit chance.
Death and Taxes: High-damage hits spend some of your health. Once your health is low, bullets can poison targets.
Dying Night: Movement boosts damage. Landing hits rapidly guarantees the Shock effect.
Genjiroh: Uses four-round bursts, a larger magazine and faster projectiles. Aiming supports four simultaneous targets. Electrical bonus damage increases the chance to shock.
Her Majesty: With Optical Camo active, shots become perfectly accurate, deal increased damage and guarantee critical headshots. Includes a dedicated silencer.
Kongou: Ricochets work without the usual cyberware. Trades magazine capacity for faster firing and reduced recoil.
La Chingona Dorada: Headshots temporarily raise critical-hit and burn chances. Single wield: the next equip grants ammunition equal to headshots scored. Dual wield: headshots immediately feed ammunition to the other weapon, up to 10 rounds. This is a source-reported 2.5 interaction, separate from base stats.
Lizzie: Adds one projectile to each shot. A full charge increases the projectile count further.
Malorian Arms 3516: Quick melee delivers a powerful incendiary strike, consuming every round remaining in the magazine.
Ogou: Shoots two-round explosive bursts with increased dismemberment chance. Dismembering a target boosts critical-hit and bleeding chances.
Pariah: An integrated suppressor allows silent Tech shots. Headshots shorten the charge and speed up reloading.
Plan B: Shots have an increased chance to cause bleeding. Firing spends your money rather than offering free ammunition.
Pride: A kill with Prejudice temporarily gives Pride ammunition-free firing. The opening shot is critical. Headshots improve at high player health and against elites.
Riskit: At very low health, handling improves and every hit becomes critical.
Rook: Includes a fitted scope and suppressor. Rapid consecutive hits build critical-hit chance while reducing accuracy; a missed shot clears the effect.
Scorch: Landing a charged shot on a burning target refunds that shot to the magazine.
Seraph: Successive hits increase the probability of igniting a target. Bullets deal extra damage to a target once it is burning.
Skippy: An AI-controlled Smart pistol with headshot-targeting and limb-targeting modes. Its quest can change the selected mode; the personality and autonomous behavior are central to its identity. The stat source also reports scaling with player level, so tier values alone are insufficient.
Amnesty: Immediately after drawing, a hip-fired headshot guarantees critical damage. This is the current source's effect; older guides may emphasize general handling bonuses instead.
Archangel: Can fire automatically in the rhythm of Samurai's song. Hits landed at short intervals build toward knocking the target down.
Bald Eagle: After Fang cripples a target, shooting that leg destroys it and recalls the knife. Also benefits attacks against moving targets.
Comrade's Hammer: The single-shot cylinder fires an explosive round. A quick melee strike automatically reloads it.
Coronation: A customization-focused iconic Tech revolver with four weapon-mod slots. The published effect specifies customization rather than a separate triggered combat ability. No undocumented damage bonus is assumed.
Crash: Briefly charge while aiming to enable automatic fire. Recoil and spread decrease, with a reduced firing rate.
Doom Doom: Each shot launches three explosive rounds. Dismemberment improves, with greater recoil and spread as the tradeoff.
Gris-Gris: Hits can upload a random quickhack through the attached cyberdeck. More powerful quickhacks have a lower activation probability.
Laika: Can apply a special burn. Hits against targets carrying that burn are critical. Burning more targets raises critical damage while worsening accuracy.
Mancinella: A suppressed revolver whose headshots can poison. Your stealth damage bonus persists briefly after combat begins.
Ol' Reliable: Switching to it boosts headshot damage and range. More distant targets receive a higher chance of critical headshots.
Rosco: Leg hits have an improved knockdown chance. Headshots against a grounded target are guaranteed critical hits.
Taigan: Can apply a special burn. Hits against targets carrying that burn are critical. Burning more targets raises critical damage while worsening accuracy.
Buzzsaw: High-penetration rounds can pass through cover. Hits to enemy limbs receive increased damage.
Chesapeake: Kills and dismemberments increase movement speed; moving faster increases damage. BARGHEST versions receive extra armor penetration.
Erebus: Fires rounds carrying Blackwall energy. Its effect is particularly effective against enemies whose health is already low; this conditional power is excluded from the base damage figures.
Fenrir: Electrical rounds can disable enemy cyberware.
Pizdets: Continuous firing raises critical-hit chance. Features a custom suppressor.
Problem Solver: Its distinctive modification pushes the firing rate toward 1,000 rounds per minute, rapidly consuming the large magazine.
Prototype: Shingen Mark V: Explosive Smart projectiles can track up to three targets simultaneously while aiming.
Raiju: Rounds pass through cover without requiring a charge. Headshots have an improved critical-hit chance.
Yinglong: Deals extra electrical damage and can trigger an EMP at the point of impact.
Carmen: Limb hits gain critical-hit chance. Running, jumping or sliding improves handling and boosts damage and bleeding.
Chinook: Kills and dismemberments increase movement speed; moving faster increases damage. BARGHEST versions receive extra armor penetration.
Divided We Stand: Tracks as many as five targets, at reduced accuracy. Projectiles can create chemical explosions that inflict strong poison effects.
Hawk: Headshots briefly mark and weaken the target: movement and outgoing damage fall, abilities are disabled, and the target becomes easier to stagger.
Hercules 3AX: Can inflict severe poison, making the victim more vulnerable to critical damage. Defeated targets explode and leave an acid pool.
Moron Labe: Dismemberment raises critical-hit chance against the victim. An uneven firing cadence makes aiming less steady.
Pit Bull: Kills and dismemberments increase movement speed; moving faster increases damage. BARGHEST versions receive extra armor penetration.
Prejudice: A Pride kill temporarily prevents Prejudice from spending ammunition. Its first shot is critical, low health increases firing rate, and elites take additional damage.
Psalm 11:6: Uses thermal explosive ammunition with an area burn effect. The acquired reference reports that these rounds cannot ricochet.
Wild Dog: Repeated hits raise firing rate and critical-hit chance. With the magazine empty, quick melee delivers greatly increased damage.
Alabai: Can apply a special burn. Hits against targets carrying that burn are critical. Burning more targets raises critical damage while worsening accuracy.
Amstaff: Kills and dismemberments increase movement speed; moving faster increases damage. BARGHEST versions receive extra armor penetration.
Ba Xing Chong: Explosive Smart ammunition can track six targets. Blasts can also harm the user. At low health, reload speed and burn chance increase.
Bloody Maria: Improves bleeding, knockdown and dismemberment. Dismembering enemies increases reload speed and critical-hit chance.
Dezerter: A kill sets the user on fire unless health is low. The self-burn grants faster movement and increased mitigation chance.
Guts: Emphasizes increased damage and firing speed at the expense of accuracy and control. Recoil is an important practical tradeoff beyond the displayed damage figure.
Mox: Modified for lower weight and improved precision. Nearby enemies face increased Shock and knockdown chances.
Order: Charging beyond 66% produces a devastating shot that leaves an EMP trail. Charge behavior is excluded from nominal damage comparisons.
Sovereign: Point-blank hits guarantee critical damage. Torso hits grant a reload-speed and movement-speed boost.
The Headsman: Fires a single slug and includes a dedicated scope. A headshot briefly improves accuracy and reload speed; a follow-up headshot becomes critical.
Hypercritical: Explosive hits knock enemies down. The magazine's final round guarantees critical damage.
Widow Maker: Each shot fires two chemical projectiles with an increased poisoning chance. Charging increases damage.
Borzaya: Can apply a special burn. Hits against targets carrying that burn are critical. Burning more targets raises critical damage while worsening accuracy.
Breakthrough: Uncharged shots can pass through walls and then ricochet repeatedly.
Foxhound: Kills and dismemberments increase movement speed; moving faster increases damage. BARGHEST versions receive extra armor penetration.
NDI Osprey: Fires explosive bursts. Headshots boost hip-fire damage. Multiple kills improve reload speed and the chance to ignite enemies.
O'Five: Explosive ammunition sets targets alight. More simultaneously burning enemies increase reload speed and critical-hit chance.
Overwatch: Combines improved reload speed with a custom suppressor.
Rasetsu: Charged shots pierce enemies and curve toward additional targets, allowing multiple enemies to be hit.
Sparky: Headshots release electrical bolts from the projectile.
Yasha: A headshot or weakspot kill briefly enables immediate locks onto other enemies' weakspots. This is the current detailed source's effect; older acquisition references describe only improved handling and mod slots.
Black Unicorn: Low stamina does not slow its attack speed.
Byakko: Allows lunging toward an enemy. A kill temporarily enables a rapid sequence of melee attacks.
Cocktail Stick: Hits delivered during Optical Camo inflict bleeding that lasts longer than the standard effect.
Errata: Allows lunging attacks. Striking a burning enemy guarantees critical damage.
Jinchu-maru: The last combo strike is critical. During Optical Camo, all strikes become critical and can lunge at the target. Elites take extra damage.
Satori: Supports lunging attacks. Holding melee while sheathed performs a quickdraw that guarantees bleeding. Against a target bleeding from Nehan, it triggers hemorrhaging, draining enemy health and healing you.
Scalpel: Sandevistan grants +50% critical-hit chance and causes strikes to inflict bleeding.
Tsumetogi: Adds electrical damage and a chance to shock. Attacks outside the standard sequence deal extra damage.
Butcher's Cleaver: Against a bleeding target, attacks become faster and consume less stamina.
Volkodav: Can apply a special burn. Hits against targets carrying that burn are critical. Burning more targets raises critical damage while worsening accuracy.
Gwynbleidd: Bosses take additional damage. Rapid kills grant a temporary period of guaranteed critical strikes, refreshed by further rapid kills. Critical player health guarantees critical strikes even without a kill chain.
Sihil: Deals bonus damage to drones, robots and mechs. Quickhacked targets take additional damage. Dashing briefly unlocks a fast melee combo.
Blue Fang: A thrown hit stuns after 1 second for a headshot or 3 seconds for another hit. Targets outside combat are stunned immediately.
Fang: Thrown hits cripple targets and stop their escape. Repeated close-range melee attacks deal increased damage. Interacts with Bald Eagle's leg-shot effect.
Headhunter: A hit marks the victim. A subsequent head attack with any weapon deals 200% damage, recalls the knife and consumes the mark. The source's '200% damage' wording is preserved as a total, not converted to +200%.
Nehan: Throwing the knife inflicts bleeding. If Satori caused the existing bleed, Nehan instead causes hemorrhaging, draining the enemy's health and restoring your own.
Stinger: Hitting a poisoned target guarantees bleeding. Hitting a bleeding target guarantees poisoning.
Agaou: Critical thrown hits create a shockwave that can damage several nearby enemies.
BFC 9000: High stamina greatly improves critical-hit chance. Has increased reach, and strong attacks receive extra damage.
Cottonmouth: Adds both electrical and chemical damage, with chances to shock or poison.
Crowbar: The bunker variant is iconic, but the available effect text supplies only flavor. No distinct triggered ability or numerical modifier could be verified; compare its sourced stats rather than assuming a hidden perk.
Murphy's Law: Striking a knocked-down enemy increases attack speed. Strong attacks receive extra damage.
Sir John Phallustiff: Face hits raise critical-hit chance. Strong attacks can stun the victim.
Tinker Bell: Trades damage for a chance to knock an enemy unconscious with a strong attack.
Baby Boomer: Successive strikes within a combo increase critical-hit chance.
Gold-Plated Baseball Bat: Has a high bleeding chance and a smaller stun chance.
Caretaker's Spade: An iconic shovel with a distinctive model. Published effect text is flavor only; no separate combat trigger or numerical modifier was verified.
Sasquatch's Hammer: Heavy strikes deliver very high damage while consuming substantial stamina. The acquisition reference also reports slow attacks, knockdown and armor penetration; those modifiers are not inferred numerically.
